Analyser des demandes de modifications lors de la phase construction Vous serez en outre chargé des échanges techniques avec les ingénieries et les entreprises de construction concernant le choix des méthodes de construction et l’évaluation de leur impact structurel ainsi que coût/planning. Vous maitrisez les Eurocodes 2, 3, 8, ainsi que les techniques de construction du génie civil (Gros et Second Œuvre). Vous maitrisez les codes de calculs de structures couramment utilisés sur les projets nucléaires. Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de synthèse tout en maitrisant la rédaction de dossiers techniques. Vous êtes force de proposition lors des étapes clés des projets et savez argumenter vos choix d’orientations. Ajouté à cela, vous savez travailler en toute autonomie tout en développant une forte appétence pour le relationnel. , Egis est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie de la construction, des transports et des services à la mobilité. Notre vocation ? Créer et exploiter des infrastructures et bâtiments intelligents au service de la transition écologique en permettant un aménagement du territoire plus équilibré et durable. Pour accompagner notre dynamique de croissance, nous offrons des opportunités de carrières variées dans près de 120 pays. Rejoindre notre Groupe et nos 18 000 collaborateurs, c'est avant tout partager nos valeurs : une entreprise humaine, impliquée dans le développement durable et dans l'innovation.

This senior leadership role is ideal for an experienced portfolio, EPMO or transformation professional who can build trusted relationships, drive continuous improvement, and lead a high-performing team to support QBCC’s transformation agenda. About QBCC As Queensland's independent building and construction regulator, we play a critical role in protecting people, supporting industry and building trust in a system that touches every part of our community, from safe homes and liveable communities to jobs and economic security. We support a $69 billion industry by protecting consumers, ensuring the industry is well supported, providing a safety net through the Home Warranty Scheme, and proactively delivering education. A thriving building and construction industry benefits us all. But it only works when people feel informed, enabled and protected. That's where we come in. We support industry, protect consumers and uphold standards. We make fair and transparent decisions, deliver services that build trust, and support a strong, sustainable industry. You will oversee portfolio definition processes from intake and assessment through to categorisation and prioritisation, while governing the development and review of investment snapshots, business cases and authority to proceed documentation. With a strong focus on benefits realisation, you will ensure investments deliver intended outcomes, measurable value and meaningful transformation for QBCC. The role also leads the development, implementation and continuous improvement of investment lifecycle frameworks, methodologies, standards and tools across project, program, portfolio and change delivery. Your leadership will help uplift delivery maturity, support consistent practices and build confidence in QBCC's transformation agenda. This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic, collaborative and outcomes-focused leader who can build trusted relationships, provide high-quality executive advice and lead a high-performing team to deliver transformation outcomes that support a thriving building and construction industry. You bring a strong understanding of investment governance, prioritisation, assurance and benefits realisation, with the ability to translate organisational strategy into clear delivery priorities and practical frameworks. Maintain a live risk register covering commercial, schedule, technical, HSE, and authority risks, with mitigation plans.
